name: Releases
description: Versions, changelogs and release notes per repository, following its release policy: set it up with Claude, see what's unreleased, release in one action, record deploys and see what's live.

tools.description: Every repository Jig knows with its release style, latest version and how much is unreleased.

What changed since the last release of a repository: its release policy, the suggested next version, unreleased commits (type, author, work items), merged pull requests and what's live per environment. Use it to answer 'what changed since the last release?' and before writing release notes.
